title: Institutional Colonnade at Blue Hour
purpose: Establishing exterior; section dividers and hero banners.
story: An institutional colonnade at blue hour — the imposing face of a public building, columns standing watch over the empty steps.
environment: A monumental portico exterior, a long colonnade above a broad flight of steps, the plaza beyond in deep dusk.
architecture: Neoclassical exterior — a row of fluted columns, a deep pedimented entablature, recessed bronze doors in shadow.
composition: The colonnade running across the frame in raking light, the steps leading up on a strong diagonal, blue-hour sky as negative space above.
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade; blue-hour sky stays cool while one warm lantern carries the brass-on-black accent from scene-01.
